cues: The pituitary releases TSH, which makes the thyroid produce thyroxine, and the thyroid needs iodine to do it.
Feed thyroxine to a young tadpole and it becomes a tiny frog far too early.
Remove its thyroid, or keep it in iodine free water, and it grows into a giant tadpole that never changes.
text: What drives it? Thyroxine. The pituitary releases TSH, which makes the thyroid produce thyroxine, and the thyroid needs iodine to do it. Feed thyroxine to a young tadpole and it becomes a tiny frog far too early. Remove its thyroid, or keep it in iodine free water, and it grows into a giant tadpole that never changes.
